notes.title: Updated SDL2 to fix DPI scaling issue
notes.notes:
The version of SDL2 we shipped with on Windows had DPI scaling bug, causing the wrong resolution to be selected whenever the game was launched. This update brings SDL2 to the latest version 2.30.11 that should fix the issue.

Thanks to the person who reported this! ːloveyouː

notes.title: Game price will be raised to $7.99 on May 1st
notes.notes:
Dear Steam community,

We would like to take this opportunity to inform you that we will be increasing the prices of our games on Steam starting next month.

We understand that this news may come as a surprise, and we want to assure you that we have not taken this decision lightly. As you're surely aware, over the past decade, the cost of development and production has increased significantly due to inflation. Inflation affects the cost of materials, wages, and other expenses, which has impacted our business operations. We need to adjust our pricing to keep up with these changes.

notes.title: Patch 1.3 released
notes.notes:
Our third patch is now live, which closes these issues:
[list]
[*]INI file parser bug fix
[*] Use desktop resolution by default, instead of the highest resolution supported
[*] Resolution can now be passed via command line, e.g.: [code]--width=1280 --height=720 --fullscreen=0[/code]
[*] Fixed loading times being too long when v-sync is active
[*] Fixed crash when there is no audio device available
[*] Fixed french translation of end screen (thanks, "Real"!)
[/list]

Thanks for reading, have fun!

notes.title: First patch has just been released!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1 is live now. The following fixes are included:

[list]
[*] Fixed a few issues with unicode paths. Non-english characters are now supported in home directory names as well as game directory names.
[*] Fixed "Invalid Operation" error caused by the Steam overlay
[*] 32bit Linux / Steam OS is now fully supported
[*] OS X build is now a universal binary (32bit and 64bit)
[*] Shaders are now working on outdated OpenGL drivers
[*] Fixed crash due to settings or savegame files being write-protected
[*] Fixed a way to pass level 58 very easily
[/list]

This covers the most urgent issues reported by all the nice folks in the forums. Thanks for your feedback!
We're busy fixing the remaining issues, and we'll keep you posted.

notes.title: About Love, Hate and the other ones — now available!
notes.notes:
About Love, Hate and the other ones is a puzzle game, in which you influence your surroundings by the force of Hate and the power of Love.

They shouldnʻt have pushed the button! Life on the hill was just perfect for Love and Hate before that shiny red device appeared. Suddenly, they are trapped in a dark and spooky cave, far away from home.

Now it is up to you to control the opposing forces of Love and Hate. They will soon meet a lot of Other Ones, wondering how they might react when Loved, or when Hated. Find a way through caves and ice, castles and factories, all by the might of your puzzling! If you ever return to that hill, life will be sweet again... 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/277680
